vllm/model_executor/layers/rotary_embedd._triton_mrope_forward:
@triton.jit
def _triton_mrope_forward(
    q_ptr,
    k_ptr,
    cos,
    sin,
    num_tokens,
    n_qh: tl.constexpr,
    n_kh: tl.constexpr,
    hd: tl.constexpr,
    rd: tl.constexpr,
    pad_n_qh: tl.constexpr,
    pad_n_kh: tl.constexpr,
    pad_hd: tl.constexpr,
    mrope_section_t: tl.constexpr,
    mrope_section_h: tl.constexpr,
    mrope_section_w: tl.constexpr,
    is_interleaved: tl.constexpr,
):
    """Triton kernel for MRoPE with support for interleaved layout.
    
    Args:
        q_ptr: pointer to query tensor [num_tokens, n_qh * hd]
        k_ptr: pointer to key tensor [num_tokens, n_kh * hd]
        cos: cosine cache [3, num_tokens, rd // 2]
        sin: sine cache [3, num_tokens, rd // 2]
        num_tokens: number of tokens
        n_qh: number of query heads
        n_kh: number of key heads
        hd: head dimension
        rd: rotary dimension (<= hd)
        pad_n_qh: padded n_qh (power of 2)
        pad_n_kh: padded n_kh (power of 2)
        pad_hd: padded hd (power of 2)
        mrope_section_t: size of T section
        mrope_section_h: size of H section
        mrope_section_w: size of W section
        is_interleaved: whether to use interleaved layout
    """
    pid = tl.program_id(0)
    # locate start address for this token
    q_ptr = q_ptr + pid * (n_qh * hd)
    k_ptr = k_ptr + pid * (n_kh * hd)
    
    half_rd = rd // 2
    
    # Get pointers to T, H, W cos/sin for this token
    # cos and sin have shape [3, num_tokens, half_rd]
    # Layout: [T values, H values, W values] for each token
    t_cos = cos + pid * half_rd
    h_cos = t_cos + num_tokens * half_rd
    w_cos = h_cos + num_tokens * half_rd
    t_sin = sin + pid * half_rd
    h_sin = t_sin + num_tokens * half_rd
    w_sin = h_sin + num_tokens * half_rd
    
    # Create offset array for half rotary dimension
    cos_offsets = tl.arange(0, pad_hd // 2)
    
    if not is_interleaved:
        # Non-interleaved: T values in first section, H in second, W in third
        # This matches _triton_qwen2vl_mrope_forward
        t_end = mrope_section_t
        h_end = t_end + mrope_section_h
        w_end = half_rd  # t_end + mrope_section_h + mrope_section_w
        
        t_mask = cos_offsets < t_end
        h_mask = (t_end <= cos_offsets) & (cos_offsets < h_end)
        w_mask = (h_end <= cos_offsets) & (cos_offsets < w_end)
        
        t_cos_row = tl.load(t_cos + cos_offsets, mask=t_mask, other=0)
        h_cos_row = tl.load(h_cos + cos_offsets, mask=h_mask, other=0)
        w_cos_row = tl.load(w_cos + cos_offsets, mask=w_mask, other=0)
        t_sin_row = tl.load(t_sin + cos_offsets, mask=t_mask, other=0)
        h_sin_row = tl.load(h_sin + cos_offsets, mask=h_mask, other=0)
        w_sin_row = tl.load(w_sin + cos_offsets, mask=w_mask, other=0)
        
        cos_row = t_cos_row + h_cos_row + w_cos_row
        sin_row = t_sin_row + h_sin_row + w_sin_row
    else:
        # Interleaved: implement apply_interleaved_rope logic
        # x_t = x[0].clone()
        # x_t[..., 1:mrope_section[1] * 3:3] = x[1, ..., 1:mrope_section[1] * 3:3]
        # x_t[..., 2:mrope_section[2] * 3:3] = x[2, ..., 2:mrope_section[2] * 3:3]
        
        # Start with T values (x[0])
        cos_row = tl.load(t_cos + cos_offsets)
        sin_row = tl.load(t_sin + cos_offsets)
        
        # Override with H values at positions 1, 4, 7, ... (every 3rd starting from 1)
        # up to mrope_section_h * 3
        h_positions = tl.arange(0, pad_hd // 2)
        h_mask = (h_positions % 3 == 1) & (h_positions < mrope_section_h * 3) & (h_positions < half_rd)
        
        # H values are stored at positions 1, 4, 7, ... in h_cos/h_sin
        # So we load from the same offset
        h_cos_vals = tl.load(h_cos + h_positions, mask=h_mask, other=0)
        h_sin_vals = tl.load(h_sin + h_positions, mask=h_mask, other=0)
        
        # Override cos_row/sin_row at H positions
        cos_row = tl.where(h_mask, h_cos_vals, cos_row)
        sin_row = tl.where(h_mask, h_sin_vals, sin_row)
        
        # Override with W values at positions 2, 5, 8, ... (every 3rd starting from 2)
        # up to mrope_section_w * 3
        w_positions = tl.arange(0, pad_hd // 2)
        w_mask = (w_positions % 3 == 2) & (w_positions < mrope_section_w * 3) & (w_positions < half_rd)
        
        w_cos_vals = tl.load(w_cos + w_positions, mask=w_mask, other=0)
        w_sin_vals = tl.load(w_sin + w_positions, mask=w_mask, other=0)
        
        cos_row = tl.where(w_mask, w_cos_vals, cos_row)
        sin_row = tl.where(w_mask, w_sin_vals, sin_row)
    
    # Now apply rotary embedding to q and k
    # left half of the head
    first_half_q_offsets = tl.arange(0, pad_n_qh)[:, None] * hd + tl.arange(
        0, pad_hd // 2)[None, :]
    first_half_k_offsets = tl.arange(0, pad_n_kh)[:, None] * hd + tl.arange(
        0, pad_hd // 2)[None, :]
    first_q_mask = (tl.arange(0, pad_n_qh)[:, None] < n_qh) & (tl.arange(
        0, pad_hd // 2)[None, :] < rd // 2)
    first_k_mask = (tl.arange(0, pad_n_kh)[:, None] < n_kh) & (tl.arange(
        0, pad_hd // 2)[None, :] < rd // 2)

    q_tile_1 = tl.load(q_ptr + first_half_q_offsets,
                       mask=first_q_mask,
                       other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)
    k_tile_1 = tl.load(k_ptr + first_half_k_offsets,
                       mask=first_k_mask,
                       other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)

    # right half of the head
    second_half_q_offsets = first_half_q_offsets + (rd // 2)
    second_half_k_offsets = first_half_k_offsets + (rd // 2)
    second_q_mask = first_q_mask
    second_k_mask = first_k_mask

    q_tile_2 = tl.load(q_ptr + second_half_q_offsets,
                       mask=second_q_mask,
                       other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)
    k_tile_2 = tl.load(k_ptr + second_half_k_offsets,
                       mask=second_k_mask,
                       other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)

    # Apply rotary embedding: y = [x1, x2] * [cos, cos] + [-x2, x1] * [sin, sin]
    new_q_tile_1 = q_tile_1 * cos_row - q_tile_2 * sin_row
    tl.store(q_ptr + first_half_q_offsets, new_q_tile_1, mask=first_q_mask)
    new_q_tile_2 = q_tile_2 * cos_row + q_tile_1 * sin_row
    tl.store(q_ptr + second_half_q_offsets, new_q_tile_2, mask=second_q_mask)

    new_k_tile_1 = k_tile_1 * cos_row - k_tile_2 * sin_row
    tl.store(k_ptr + first_half_k_offsets, new_k_tile_1, mask=first_k_mask)
    new_k_tile_2 = k_tile_2 * cos_row + k_tile_1 * sin_row
    tl.store(k_ptr + second_half_k_offsets, new_k_tile_2, mask=second_k_mask)
